en.title: Maximize Total Profit by Assigning Chefs to Dishes
en.description:
Each chef makes at most one dish, and a dish can be chosen by several chefs; a chef can only make dishes whose difficulty ≤ the chef's skill, and each chef chooses the highest profit among the dishes they can make. If a chef can make no dish, the profit is 0.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and do not mean that the original problem provides these limits.
en.input: n (1..200000) and n skill values; m (1..200000), m difficulties, and m profits; all values are 0..10⁹. This site adopts the typical limits given by the original problem.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
